state_model.current_state_rationale: Canonical selection and cross-platform containment are verified. Exercise Assurance staffing and production key custody still require independently verifiable external evidence.
state_model.rule: No state may be skipped. Green test suites are not a substitute for a state transition.

transitions.DESIGN_COMPLETE -> PREREQUISITES_PENDING: Charters, RACI, gates, scorecards, and trust model ratified
transitions.PREREQUISITES_PENDING -> ASSESSMENT_READ: ALL four required_gates verified with evidence
transitions.ASSESSMENT_READY -> EXERCISE_AUTHORIZED: Signed RoE, safety assessment approved, contact roster live-tested, inject commitment published
transitions.EXERCISE_AUTHORIZED -> EXERCISE_COMPLETE: Execution finished or terminated; cleanup verified by a non-operator
transitions.EXERCISE_COMPLETE -> EVIDENCE_VERIFIED: Exercise Assurance validates evidence completeness and integrity; ledger verifies and seals
transitions.EVIDENCE_VERIFIED -> ASSESSMENT_ISSUED: Scores computed against the frozen rubric and signed with the assessment key

to_PREREQUISITES_PENDING: Any required gate ceases to hold
Signing key found outside its designated custody
Exercise Assurance performer unavailable or conflicted

presentation_rules: While status is NOT_ASSESSMENT_READY, exercises MAY run and diagnostic scores MAY be computed.
No assurance statement may be issued.
Every artifact produced in this state carries the marking TRAINING_OR_ENGINEERING_USE_ONLY.
A diagnostic score must never be forwarded to an auditor, regulator, customer, or board as assurance evidence.
Removing the marking requires a state transition, not an editorial decision.
